scope: Full frozen qa_contract.py and qa_adapter.py read, their exact R5-to-R6 deltas, and cross-language fields/exception/restoration against the previously completed full R6 Java caller review. No target Python controls, Java compilation, device call, Hepta call, or UI action was executed.

findings.conclusion: The new plan has one reveal action nonce, distinct before/inspect/after/action nonces and no selector or arbitrary point. Session.sequence derives request fields from its own just-completed parsed inspect result after rechecking foreground scope. The Java side reopens its own nonce-bound persisted inspection, checks its digest and freshness, repeats complete target/final-window inspection, and recomputes the same player proof. Old retained UI trees are not accepted as independent action authority.

Python player_reveal_scope repeats the same exact course activity, title and author hashes, eligible complete node roles, absolute viewport/full-area geometry, two SurfaceViews and distinct parents, hidden control container and noninteractive-player checks read in Java. Canonical proof has nine matching fields; same_reveal_frame compares the same eight stable fields, permitting only the intended controls-tree evolution. The action coordinate is derived as the viewport center with a strict greater-than-16-pixel margin on all sides, not taken from a caller-supplied coordinate.

findings.area: Success receipt and actual input acknowledgement
findings.conclusion: The reveal branch remains behind parse_completed: exact request/nonce/protocol/UID binding, canonical bounded gzip result, unique instrumentation finish(-1), actual joined command and SHA receipt, no helper error or secondary error, complete three-capture sequence, window/cache readiness and service restoration. assess_reveal requires all thirty exact touch fields, runtime SDK at least 34, explicit public display factory, display zero/source touchscreen/single pointer, acknowledged DOWN and UP, no CANCEL success-path flags, all created events recycled, correct interior point and 150ms UP-admission limit. Post-input inspection is complete and recomputed to the same absolute player frame.

Both Flow.begin and the instrumentation call classify reveal_controls as a mutation. Session.instrument records the nonce in its set before any attempt and persists one request, then requires exactly one additional held recorder command; it contains no input retry or fallback. The helper claim/work and independent postguard contracts remain required. The existing action lock is acquired once around the sequence and closed once in the original finally path.

Session.sequence clears middle before calling the action, so an action/assessment failure cannot reuse the earlier inspect as successful mutation evidence. Its finally attempts one distinct after-state command once state sequencing began, even after inspect or action failure; a failed transport guard remains failure. When available, before/middle/after state and helper UID must agree, and service flags/capabilities restore before success. Foreground must remain exact for reveal; owned task and installed signed APK bytes are rechecked. The first exception is retained; subsequent state/foreground/task/install and final Main/release errors remain secondary, never converted to success.

A finish(0) failure cannot pass parse_completed. Optional failure_diagnostic extracts bounded metadata/touch observations only and is marked unqualified; diagnostic extraction failure leaves the original exception intact. Success explicitly keeps controls_revealed null, business/audio/whole-app success false, outcome_unknown tied to attempted action and independent controls readback required. The input transaction is not claimed atomic against window changes, and the inherited Java Error, hard-kill, permanently blocked Binder or unsuccessful CANCEL limits remain.

unchanged_boundaries: Exact recorder manifest and held transport authority
Original task ownership; this adapter does not itself launch or close application tasks
Existing Main guards, connection flags, cache/window selection, ordinary inspect/click/edit and restore semantics
No hidden API, reflection beyond the reviewed public MotionEvent overload, or event-target attribution guarantee added
